speaker: husband
text: [tired] Loretta, please. [sighs] I come from a very long day at work.

speaker: loretta
text: [sarcastic] Oh. [pause] A long day. [pause] With Lisa.

speaker: husband
text: [exasperated] Not this again! [firmly] She is just a co-worker.

speaker: loretta
text: [fast] Then why is she always messaging you? [shouting] And always adding those little hearts under your messages!

speaker: husband
text: [shouting] Those are emojis, Loretta! Everybody sends emojis!

speaker: loretta
text: [mocking] And how come you work so hard, so late, [pause] and you never get a raise?

speaker: husband
text: [sighs] I don't know, Loretta. [pause] But here's what I hope will happen. [hopeful] My boss will finally notice everything I do. And he'll give me a raise. [sarcastic] A raise so big, that maybe your father will finally be proud of who you married.

speaker: loretta
text: [sharp] Don't you bring my father into this.

speaker: husband
text: [shouting] Your father never liked me! [pause] [bitter] He called me a clank. [pause] [crying] A clank, Loretta. [sniffs] At Thanksgiving.

speaker: loretta
text: [shouting] Oh my god, let it go! [fast] It was fifteen years ago. He's old school, and you and I have always looked so different. [softer] He needed time to accept you.

speaker: husband
text: [sighs] [weary] But honestly, Loretta... [pause] sometimes I even wonder if the kids are really mine.

speaker: loretta
text: [nervous] Whaaat? [pause] What do you mean? [sweetly] They look just like us.

speaker: husband
text: [thoughtful] Pixel, yes. Servo, yes. [pause] But honestly, the third one... [pause] Wally looks so different.

speaker: loretta
text: [fast] Not at all! [pause] [tender] Wally looks just like you.

speaker: larry
text: [cheerful] Yeah. Don't go imagining things, buddy.

speaker: husband
text: [relieved] Oh, thank you, Larry. [pause] Thank you for being such a good friend.
